```{r results = 'asis' , echo = FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
cat('\n')
cat("####", "Volcano Plot")

plot_enhanced_volcano(all_contrasts[[name]])
cat('\n')             


cat('\n')
cat("####", "MA Plot")
cat('\n')
plot_ma(all_contrasts[[name]])
cat('\n')


cat('\n')
cat("####", "Top Up/Downregulated Genes {.tabset .tabset-pills}")
cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Top Up-regulated Genes")
cat('\n')
Top_up_filename <- file.path(saveDir, "contrasts", name, "Top_up_DEGs.jpeg")
if(file.exists(Top_up_filename)){
cat('\n')
writeLines(paste0("![](",Top_up_filename,")"))
cat('\n\n')
}else{
  cat("No significant upregulated genes")
}
cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Top Down-regulated Genes")
cat('\n')
Top_dn_filename <- file.path(saveDir, "contrasts", name, "Top_dn_DEGs.jpeg")
if(file.exists(Top_dn_filename)){
cat('\n')
writeLines(paste0("![](",Top_dn_filename,")"))
cat('\n\n')
}else{
  cat("No significant upregulated genes")
}
cat('\n\n')


cat('\n')
cat("####", "Table of DE genes")
cat('\n')

display_de_genes4(mytable = all_contrasts[[name]], geneAnns = geneAnns, filter = TRUE, distinct = TRUE, padj_cutoff = 0.2)

cat('\n')
```

### Pathway enrichment GSEA {.tabset}
```{r results = 'asis' , echo = FALSE, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
cat('\n')
cat("####", "Hallmark {.tabset}")
cat('\n')

res_hall <- gsea_results_logpval(all_contrasts[[name]], geneset = Hallmark, name, Chemo_path = params$Chemo_path, Cellline = params$cell_line , Celline_Dict_Chemo_path = params$Cell_Dict_path, drug = params$drug, TPM_expr_path )

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Signficance and GeneRatios")
cat('\n')
dotplot(res_hall$gseares_all)
cat('\n')

# filename <- paste("Hallmark", "Dotplot", name,'.jpeg', sep = '_')
# filepath <- file.path(saveDir,"contrasts",name, "gsea_res", "Hallmark", filename )
# dotplot(res_hall$gseares)
# cat('\n')
# jpeg(file = filepath, width = 8, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)
# dotplot(res_hall$gseares)
# dev.off()
# cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Visualization pathways")
cat('\n')
filename <- paste("Hallmark", "DotplotV2", name,'.jpeg', sep = '_')
filepath <- file.path(saveDir,"contrasts",name, "gsea_res", "Hallmark", filename )

VisualPathways(res_hall$gsea_table, filepath)
cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Genes within pathways")
cat('\n')
cnetplot(res_hall$gseares_all, cex_label_gene=0.5, cex_label_category = 0.8, showCategory = 10)
cat('\n')


cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Tree: pathway cluster ")
cat('\n')
if(nrow(res_hall$gsea_table) > 5){
sim <- pairwise_termsim(res_hall$gseares_all)
treeplot(sim, hclust_method = 'average')
}else{
    cat('\n')
    cat("**", paste("Not enough pathways to fit a tree"), "**\n")
    cat('\n')
}
cat('\n')


cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Top upregulated")
cat('\n')

plot_top_gsea(res_hall, top='up')
cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Top Downregulated")
cat('\n')

plot_top_gsea(res_hall, top='down')
cat('\n')

cat('\n')
cat("#####", "Table of enriched pathways")
cat('\n')

downloadableDTExcel(res_hall$gsea_table %>% select(ID, pathway,pval, padj, ES, NES, size, core_enrichment, link,Target_Chemo_esp, Target_Chemo_all), escape=FALSE) %>% formatSignif(columns = c('pval','padj', 'ES', 'NES'), digits = 3)
```
